text.tspan: – match Bellman backups, not next latents

g.text: module: the model is scored by the VALUE it implies, not by the latent it emits
= V from T4, its weights FROZEN
the latent MSE weights every transition equally; this one weights each by how much the VALUE moves – so the 48% no-ops cost ~0
